notes.title: Ancient Gods patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Ancient Gods patch 1.1.0 is LIVE now![/h3]

[h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 19 achievements to the game
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/5df384fb897209df0c63c4014fafd62cfcfaad62.png[/img]

[h3][b]New mode: Challenge[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/b0d0d460cd613b39cf91b2f8bdf4342db92158eb.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Players will use pre-set cards and characters for each level to complete the goal.
[*] It teaches the basics of the game, as well as the usage of various [b]keywords[/b].
[*] In addition, high levels will create challenges even for experienced players.
[/list]

[h3][b]New mechanism: Curse[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/14ae69f8fc4ab40972b2d812273d160cb0a8d50b.png[/img]
When entering a region in endless mode, you will receive harmful effects in that region. Currently, there will be 3 types of Curse, its strength increases with their level.
[list]
[*] Jinx: At the start of combat, add the Jinx card to your draw pile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/1a858b7176f101d68573ae7f94e78b4494a9718e.png[/img]
[*] Medusa Eyes: If your deck has less than a certain number of cards, at the start of combat, add 5 random Curse cards to your draw pile
[*] Dragon's Curse: Your Block cannot exceed x% Your Block cannot exceed
[/list]

[h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/8c4351d6e3260f2ad8b7137feebc7e53e571bc95.png[/img]
[list]
[*] You can now use the right mouse button to play cards.
[*] Speed up the animation of drawing and adding cards to the draw pile, hand as well as discard pile.
[*] Displays the number of cards in the discard pile and draw pile.
[*] Add Hide button in Starting hand.
[*] Displays character's health in %.
[*] Show the gem's tooltip in the gem attachment.
[*] Display the names of the gods in the Wishlist.
[*] Change the color of the Abandon button.
[*] Change UI of Endless mode results.
[*] Round numbers with more than 4 digits.
[*] Added Enhance button in the character selection screen
[/list]

[h3][b]Change the character displayed in the Main Menu[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can choose the character you own to display in the Main Menu
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/26c1dedd8cd709237fc97a8e8410bf58443806a8.png[/img]

[h3][b]Fixed bugs[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made enemies live with 0 HP.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Mana burn card didn't subtract mana.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Blizzard card counted the number of Frost cards played by turn but not by combat.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "out of stock" book can still be purchased.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you press the skill too quickly, it won't activate.
[*] Fixed a bug where discarded cards are consumed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Red combo didn't apply the Charge buff.
[*] Fixed a bug where damage from Burn or Poison didn't update when the opponent was under Immortal.
[*] Fixed a bug where Thoth Passive displayed the wrong description.
[*] Fixed a bug where the vulnerable effect could be negative.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Miasa card didn't work as described.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Dream Coil card made Maximum mana negative.
[*] Fixed a bug where using Cold Embrace two turns in a row makes you unable to use attacks for the rest of the combat.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Super Guard stack was reduced to 0 after just one hit.
[/list]

[h3][b]Others[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimize the game significantly
[*] New Tutorial
[*] Change the icon of gold and diamond
[/list]

That's all in this update. Remember if you wanna talk about Ancient Gods or simply chat with people I suggest you join our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/Ge8kBBSgDE

notes.title: Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
[h2]Yes, the game is out of Early Access[/h2]

The game today really has a big contribution from you guys. We hope you continue to join us in making Ancient Gods more and more perfect.

However we are still not satisfied with it. We will be [b]expanding the game further[/b], either through [b]normal updates[/b], DLCs with additional content, or both. The community deserves it.

Check out the Ancient Gods Launch Trailer
[previewyoutube=xuQNxIpi40M;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ancient Gods patch 1.0.0 is LIVE now
notes.content:
So a long journey of 9 months has passed. We have reached a new milestone but not the final one.

[h3]Today we are officially out of Early Access[/h3]

And it is marked with version 1.0.0

Since the beginning of Early Access, the community has been nothing but awesome! I've met many great people and I'm proud to say that most of them are still here, playing, chatting and having fun. Yes, the game is out of Early Access however we are still not satisfied with it. We will be [b]expanding the game further[/b], either through [b]normal updates[/b], DLCs with additional content, or both. The community deserves it.
The game today really has a big contribution from you guys. We hope you continue to join us in making Ancient Gods more and more perfect.

Back to Patch 1.0.0 change-log
[list]
[*] Increase the amount of Gold and Diamond drop.
[*] Removes Gold and Diamond limits when defeated, you will instead lose 60% if defeated.
[*] Forgotten Lake, Cleanse Fountain and Treasure events upgrade.
[*] Skill system rework.
[*] Add New Skills.
[*] Gems that cannot be used will no longer drop.
[*] Balance some cards.
[*] Removed Japanese - sorry, we'll bring it back in the near future
[*] Fixed some bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Ancient Gods patch 0.1.0
notes.content:
Ancient Gods patch 0.1.0
[h3]The update will be released tomorrow 16/12/2021 UTC+0[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/71f5652bdeafcc3123f0fd70215cd69a78ff86c5.png[/img]
[h3]Classes rework:[/h3]
[list][*] You must choose exactly 3 classes for your god.
[*] The chosen classes will decide the available card pool for that run.[/list]
[h3]Pure combo rework:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now pure combo will convert the current combo to pure combo and keep the amount of combos.
[*] Pure combo when receiving another combo will change to that combo and keep the same amount.
[/list]
-> Pure card will act as a bridge between combo types to serve hybrid decks.
[h3]Starting deck rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] The starting deck is decided by the composition of chosen classes/
[/list]
[i][h2]New feature[/h2][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/e262305dcf2bbd9dc5ed31f80dc88b7d82b70a47.png[/img]

[list]

[h3]New event: Cleansing Fountain [/h3]
[list]
[*] An event capable of removing cursed cards
[*] The number of cards removed will depend on the result when rolling 2 dice at the same time.
[/list]
[i][h2]Balance[/h2][/i]
[list]
[*] Increase the speed of scaling the opponent's strength in endless
[*] Adjusted Campaign rewards: Give more gods instead of shards and diamonds
[*] Gold and diamonds earned by events or battles will scale according to the current stage
[*] Life steal's mana cost reduced from 1 to 0
[*] Phalanx's mana cost reduced from 3 to 1
[*] Ares's passive will no longer receive overloads
[*] Add 2 new monster's passives: Shield Block & Recover
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can cancel discard.
[*] Added quest info, you can track quest progress while you're exploring.

[b][h3]WARNING: This update will reset all quests and rewards in the campaign. Unfinished runs will automatically be abandoned, so please complete them before the update 👀 [/h3][/b]

[list]
[*] Visual bug that retains previous opponent's block
[*] Bug where Odin casts passive every time he uses 1 mana

notes.title: ANCIENT GODS IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey there everyone! It's finally time for us all to experience the Early Access version

ANCIENT GODS IS OUT NOW!

Thank you so much for all of your support and love over the last few months, your support, feedback and encouragement have been invaluable to us!

We will shut down the demo version, all demo data will be reset

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41032129/e15ed3ff6e938022d3fcf501faa39dbb52db4f95.png[/img]

We’re all incredibly proud of how Ancient Gods has progressed, and we hope you all enjoy it as much as we've enjoyed working on it. It's been very emotional seeing it all come together, and we can't wait to start seeing what you experience!

If you're interested in WHAT THE FUTURE HOLDS, we've got a roadmap you can Join our Discord community - [url=https://discord.gg/7tHDUFN73w]Here[/url], we can't wait to fill it up with a mix of all of our ideas! If you have suggestions, feel free to pop them in the suggestions channel!

If you run into any problems, please don't hesitate to let us know - we've got bug report channel for you!

Less than three,
Hexpion

notes.title: Ancient God Demo patch 0.1.0 is Live NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

This is our first update, and here is the full change-log:
ːriftfireːREPLACED all [b]Passive icons[/b].
ːriftfireːREPLACED [b]Card icon[/b]: Amplify, Last Strike (to make it easier to distinguish).
ːriftfireːADDED [b]Starting hand redraw[/b] mechanic: Now you can [b]keep[/b] or [b]redraw[/b] your first hand every battle.
ːriftfireːADDED effect for [b]playable[/b] card (white) and card with [b]activation conditions[/b] (yellow when it met the condition).
Fixed bug
ːriftwaterːFIXED bug that keeps the effect icon from the previous battle.
ːriftwaterːFIXED bug that makes language changed to default after restarting the game
